messages:
maya: Quick runtime follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A about batching/caching/kernels.
maya: 1) Can customers pin kernels in Dedicated and expect consistent fallbacks?
taylor: Dedicated alpha will support kernel_profile in the manifest. Fallback chain is pinned -> compatible-quant -> generic by default.
alex: Well add a preflight compatibility API to validate a pin won't break rollbacks.
rami: 2) Autoscaler metric: which percentile should be the default for batch-trigger decisions?
taylor: Default is p99.5 for autoscaling; ops can opt into p99.9. Console shows p50/p90/p99/p99.9.
ops-bot: [notice] Sampling for high-cardinality trace fields is set to 1% by default; Dedicated can raise it.
maya: Please publish a short RFC covering kernel pinning, autoscale percentiles, and KV prewarm options.
taylor: Will publish RFC and migration checklist in the next 7 days and post link here.
maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
_metadata_note: No title per agents.md. Single continuous message string with sender prefixes. Timestamps plausible and last >= first.
